analytics_public_metrics_disclaimer_lead: Public and third-party metrics shown here (including publicly visible Spotify popularity such as monthly listeners, followers, and track play counts, and similar external sources) are approximate, may be incomplete, delayed, or incorrect, and are not cleaned against royalty statements. They can and often will diverge from your official statement and settlement numbers.
analytics_public_metrics_disclaimer_trut: Only approved royalty statements and the settlement ledger are authoritative for streams, revenue, balances, and payouts. Public charts are for orientation and marketing insight only.
analytics_public_metrics_disclaimer_why_: Why these numbers can differ from settlement data
Different definitions: e.g. monthly listeners and public play counts are not the same as royalty-eligible streams reported by distributors or DSPs for a settlement period.
Different time windows and reporting lag: public snapshots are point-in-time scrapes; statements cover contractual reporting periods with later corrections.
Incomplete coverage: not every release, territory, product type, or historical period may be scraped or displayed.
No financial reconciliation: freemium vs premium, skips, fraud filters, content ID, splits, deductions, advances, and contract rates are not applied to public figures.
Third-party / public sources without warranty: values can be rounded, estimated, cached, or temporarily wrong on the source side.
Possible double counts, missing tracks, renamed releases, or catalogue mismatches between public pages and the catalogue used for statements.
analytics_public_metrics_disclaimer_lega: All public and third-party analytics on this page are provided “as is” and “as available”, solely for general information and orientation. They do not constitute accounting records, a royalty statement, a guarantee of accuracy or completeness, financial advice, or a basis for payment claims.

To the extent permitted by applicable law, the label and platform operators accept no liability for decisions, losses, or claims based on these public figures, including any discrepancy versus official statements or settlements. Mandatory liability for intent, gross negligence, injury to life, body or health, and non-excludable statutory duties remains unaffected.

Using this view does not create any claim to a particular payout, stream total, or ranking. Binding commercial figures are solely those shown in approved statements and the settlement process agreed with the label.
analytics_pdf_disclaimer: Disclaimer: Public Spotify and other third-party metrics in this report are approximate, unreconciled, non-binding estimates and may differ from royalty statements and settlements. Only approved statements and the settlement ledger are authoritative for payouts. Provided as-is; no warranty of accuracy. Liability excluded to the extent permitted by law.

statements_trust_lead: Royalty statements are built from archived distributor source files (Statement of Sales / SOS), not from Spotify for Artists or public scrapes. You can inspect chain-of-custody details on each statement.
statements_trust_point_1: Each linked statement can show distributor, reporting period, archive timestamp, and SHA-256 of the original source CSV.
statements_trust_point_2: You can download the archived source CSV and re-hash it yourself to verify the file was not altered after import.
statements_trust_point_3: Binding payout amounts remain the approved statement PDF and settlement process — provenance proves origin, not identity with marketing dashboards.
statements_trust_s4a_note: Spotify for Artists, charts, and public presence numbers use different definitions, filters, and time windows. Differences versus SOS are expected and do not mean the statement is “fake”.
statements_provenance_lead: These figures come from a distributor import batch stored immutably as bronze archive. Recalculate SHA-256 on the downloaded file to verify integrity.
statements_provenance_hash_none: No hash recorded for this batch
statements_provenance_download_error: Could not download source archive. Contact the label if this persists.
statements_provenance_verify_hint: Verify: download the CSV, compute SHA-256, and compare with the hash above. Match = same bytes as archived at import.
statements_provenance_missing: No distributor source batch is linked to this statement (manual PDF upload or legacy row). Ask the label for the original SOS file if you need an audit trail.

invoice_assistant_need_statement: This statement cannot be invoiced yet (status or amount).
invoice_assistant_need_review: Enter invoice number and due date.
invoice_assistant_iban_nudge: For SEPA payouts, complete bank details under Billing.
invoice_quick_confirm_body: Create and send an invoice for {period} ({amount}) to the label. Prefer the assistant if you want to review details first.
fan_assistant_mode_subtitle: New here? The assistant picks a layout and walks you to review or publish.
fan_assistant_mode_assistant_desc: Template → checks → publish. Recommended for first launch.
fan_assistant_coach_template_body: Start from a template. You can refine everything later in the full editor.
fan_assistant_coach_checklist_body: Fix blocking errors before publishing. Warnings are optional.
fan_assistant_coach_publish_body: Submit for label review, or publish immediately if trusted.
fan_assistant_need_template: Pick a layout template to continue.
fan_assistant_need_publish_ready: Add at least two sections before publishing.
fan_assistant_publish_summary: Ready when checks pass. You can still open the full editor anytime.
epk_assistant_mode_subtitle: Get a PDF or share link without learning the full canvas editor first.
epk_assistant_mode_assistant_desc: Template → export or share. Recommended first run.
epk_assistant_mode_advanced_desc: Layers, pages, fonts, and advanced tools.
epk_assistant_what_next_2: Download PDF or create a share link
epk_assistant_what_next_3: Open the full editor for fine-tuning
epk_assistant_coach_template_body: We fill artist name and assets where possible.
epk_assistant_coach_export_body: Download a PDF for email, or create a link for journalists.
epk_assistant_coach_done_body: Open the full editor anytime to refine the layout.
epk_assistant_done_body: Your kit is ready to refine or share.
tour_guide_subheading: Create and manage a tour with checks, exports, and a public share link.
tour_guide_mode_title: How do you want to plan?
tour_guide_mode_subtitle: Start with the assistant for a guided production flow, or open Advanced for full control.
tour_guide_mode_assistant_desc: Step-by-step: name the tour, import shows, set defaults, fix readiness issues, export PDFs and share.
tour_guide_mode_advanced_desc: Full tabs for stops, route, crew, merch, finance, and settings.
tour_guide_mode_next_1: Import upcoming concerts as tour stops
tour_guide_mode_next_2: See readiness score and fix gaps before the run
tour_guide_mode_next_3: Export itinerary PDF and share a read-only link
tour_guide_coach_basics_body: Use a clear name the crew will recognise. You can change currency and description later.
tour_guide_coach_stops_body: Pick upcoming concerts to import as stops. Linked venues and dates come from your events calendar.
tour_guide_coach_defaults_body: Vehicle and planning mode feed route calculations. Refine per stop in Advanced.
tour_guide_coach_readiness_body: We flag missing deals, schedules, geocodes, and clashes so nothing critical is forgotten.
tour_guide_coach_share_body: Download an itinerary PDF and create a public read-only link (logistics + deal framework only).
tour_guide_need_name: Enter a tour name to continue.
tour_guide_need_stops: Select at least one concert or create the tour first.
tour_guide_create_first: Continue once to create the tour, then select concerts.
tour_guide_stops_intro: Select concerts to import as tour stops (dates and venues prefilled).
tour_guide_no_concerts: No upcoming concerts left to import. Add stops in Advanced or create events first.
tour_guide_readiness_hint: 100 = production-ready. Warnings are OK to ship with; errors block finish.
tour_guide_share_intro: Export PDFs for the crew, or create a public link for promoters (no guest lists or settlements).
tour_guide_share_hint: Shows dates, venues, schedule times, and deal framework — not settlements or guest lists.
tour_guide_manage_advanced_hint: Use Advanced for crew, merch, tasks, and per-stop finance detail.
tour_guide_issue_no_stops_body: Add at least one show or travel day.
tour_guide_issue_no_stops_fix: Import concerts in the Dates step or add stops in Advanced.
tour_guide_issue_date_order_body: Stop on {date} ({venue}) is before an earlier date in the list.
tour_guide_issue_date_order_fix: Reorder stops by date in Advanced.
tour_guide_issue_overlap_fix: Confirm intentional double-shows or move one date.
tour_guide_issue_radius_fix: Adjust dates, venues, or radius in settings.
tour_guide_issue_ungeocoded_body: {venue} has no coordinates — routing will fail.
tour_guide_issue_ungeocoded_fix: Geocode the venue in Advanced → stop detail.
tour_guide_issue_no_deal_body: {venue} is confirmed but has no deal framework.
tour_guide_issue_no_schedule_body: {venue} is confirmed but has no stage time.
tour_guide_issue_no_schedule_fix: Fill day schedule on the stop.
tour_guide_issue_no_hotel_fix: Optional but useful for day sheets.
tour_guide_issue_tech_docs_body: Tour has no tech rider / stage plot uploaded yet.
tour_guide_issue_budget_body: No budget lines or total set for this tour.
tour_guide_issue_next48_body: Next show: {venue}. Export a day sheet soon.
tour_guide_issue_next48_fix: Open Advanced → stop → Day sheet PDF.
tour_share_public_disclaimer: Read-only logistics and deal framework. Not a settlement or guest list.
tour_mode_empty: No stops cached for this tour. Open online once to load dates, then you can use Tour mode offline.
billing_tax_status_hint: Controls VAT presentation on generated invoices (§ 14 UStG).
onboarding_terms_body: Please read and accept the Artist Portal terms before continuing.
onboarding_terms_checkbox: I have read and accept the terms.
portal_terms_gate_body: Please accept the current terms of use and settlement to continue using the portal.
billing_vies_valid: VAT ID confirmed in EU VIES
billing_vies_invalid: VAT ID is invalid in VIES
